$comment: ADR alignment: every ADR has standard status, README index is complete and consistent, no duplicates, no dialect disagreements.

criteria.target: test $(cd /home/ubuntu/jupyter-notebook-validator-operator && for f in docs/adrs/0*.md; do s=$(grep -A1 '^## Status' "$f" | tail -1 | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$s" ] && echo BLANK; done | wc -l) -eq 0
test $(cd /home/ubuntu/jupyter-notebook-validator-operator && ls docs/adrs/0*.md | sed 's|.*/||' | grep -oP '^\d+' | sort | uniq -d | wc -l) -eq 0

test $(cd /home/ubuntu/jupyter-notebook-validator-operator && for f in docs/adrs/0*.md; do num=$(basename "$f" | grep -oP '^\d+'); grep -qP "^\| \[0*${num}\]" docs/adrs/README.md || echo MISSING; done | wc -l) -eq 0
